Author: BlueWaveXIV
Name: AutoBuy
Description: Private Market Board helper that searches configured gear keywords and buys listings at or below a configurable gil cap.
Punchline: Buy underpriced gear sets from the Market Board.
Changelog: Made successful prize trades resilient to delayed inventory updates: Porter now waits briefly for settlement after the trade window closes, accepts the normal occupied state during an active trade, and keeps confirmed offers valid through transient UI cleanup. Added a visible Copy log button to the Porter operational log.
